name: review_skill
description: Gather skill prompt data and resolve variant paths for generating a model-tuned system_prompt.md. Returns the root prompt, tool signatures, resolved provider/model, and target write path. After receiving the result, adapt the prompt for the target model and write it using write_agent_file.

skill_name.description: Skill name to review, or '*' for batch mode (returns list of all eligible skills)

dry_run.description: If true, return data for review without expecting a write afterward

force.description: If true, include skills that already have variants for the current model (overwrite mode)
